title: german services sector downturn eases august stronger demand hiring 2026 09 03
text:
BERLIN, Sept 3 (Reuters) - Germany's services sector contracted marginally in August as tougher financial conditions, high costs and customer caution weighed on ​activity, a business survey showed on Thursday.
The final S&P ‌Global Germany Services Purchasing Managers' Index fell to 49.7 in August from 49.8 in July, coming in well above an initial reading of ​48.5.
